notes: «- واللفظ لأبي بكر -» is the compiler's gloss and is left out
Alqama narrates an encounter: Abu al-Darda speaks inside it («فأتانا أبو الدرداء فقال أفيكم أحد») and gives the saying in his own words, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5)
«عبد الله» appears only as the Qur'an reader Alqama heard, not as a speaker, so no link
